visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a long black braid, wearing a light beige mesh top and black high-waisted leggings, stands centered in a white-paneled hallway. She has her right leg bent and hooked behind her left knee. She looks at the camera with a neutral expression, preparing for a movement. (2) The woman bends forward, reaches for her right foot, and smoothly pulls it up towards her chest while straightening her body. She ends in a yoga-like pose with her foot held high and hands pressed together in a prayer position. She smiles brightly at the camera. (3) The scene cuts to a different woman in a home setting. She is wearing a black sports bra and patterned leggings, standing on a tiger-design yoga mat. She successfully repeats the leg-lifting flexibility challenge with balance. The background shows a modern living room with warm indoor lighting. (4) A final cut shows a third woman in a blue top and grey leggings in another indoor domestic setting with a distinct arched doorway in the background. She also executes the leg-hooked stretch with a confident smile. The camera remains static eye-level throughout these shots.
